correctness.rationale: Nonoverlap forces disjoint occurrence blocks. Inclusion–exclusion and exact character summation imply divisibility by 2^r; a frequency supported on the first floor(n/k)k coordinates requires one unique maximal packing and attains exactly ±2^r. The single complete tiling proves all multipliers odd when r=0, and one-hole packings give the exact affine parity expression when r=1. Both independent integer checkers executed from the package and passed; no finite computation is relied upon as the all-length proof.
